name: routeshred
description: RouteShred - Open-source bike route planner for road and gravel bikes

scripts.dev:free-frontend-port: sh -c 'pids=$(lsof -ti tcp:3000); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then echo Stopping existing frontend on :3000 "$pids"; kill $pids; fi'
scripts.dev:free-backend-port: sh -c 'pids=$(lsof -ti tcp:5050); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then echo Stopping existing backend on :5050 "$pids"; kill $pids; fi'
scripts.dev:brouter: npm run dev:free-frontend-port && npm run dev:free-backend-port && ROUTING_ENGINE=brouter BROUTER_API=http://localhost:17777/brouter concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=frontend" "npm run dev --workspace=backend"
scripts.dev:brouter:docker: sh -c 'npm run brouter:up; cleanup(){ npm run brouter:down >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }; trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM; npm run dev:brouter'
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=frontend && npm run build --workspace=backend
scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --workspace=frontend && npm install --workspace=backend
